title: Spec 0007: shared tests
description: Add all tests for spec 0007. CookbookCore (Swift Testing, `import Testing`): extend `ShoppingListTests.swift` or add `ShoppingListMutationTests.swift` — seven scenarios covering `updateItem` (text replacement, bracket preservation, no-op for non-item lines) and `appendItem(_:toAisle:)` (section insertion, case-insensitive heading match, new section creation, preservation of other sections, items-before-first-heading). CookbookApp: add `ShoppingListAisleGrouperTests.swift` (nil bucket, section switch, consecutive headings), `ShoppingListFilesTests.swift` (discovery count, reverse-mtime sort, display-name derivation via temp directory), `AisleCatalogTests.swift` (load from fixture, canonical fallback when absent, re-load on folder change), and view-structure tests verifying list view (search field present, FAB rendered, no folder/⋯ toolbar) and detail view (aisle sections rendered, swipe actions wired, AddItemSheet contains TextField and Picker). Run `xcodebuild test` to confirm all pass.
acceptance_criteria: updateItemReplacesTextPreservingBracket: text becomes `- [ ] *500 g* spinach` (bracket unchanged)
appendItemToExistingAisleInsertsAtSectionEnd: new item between broccoli and `## dairy` heading
appendItemToAisleIsCaseInsensitive: `## Produce` and `produce` match as the same aisle

appendItemCreatesNewAisleHeadingWhenAbsent: `
## dairy
- [ ] milk
` appended, produce section unchanged
ShoppingListAisleGrouperTests: nil bucket, section switch, multiple consecutive headings all pass
ShoppingListFilesTests: correct count, reverse-mtime order, `.md` extension stripped
AisleCatalogTests: load from aisle.conf returns ordered aisles; absent config returns canonical fallback list; re-load replaces cache
View-structure tests for list view and detail view pass
